name: CLB v6.8.5 Gallery Responsive + Rights & Security
notes: Gallery uses 3 artworks per page on desktop and 2 on compact/mobile layouts including landscape phones; page position is preserved across rotation. Adds CSP hardening, external-frame referrer hardening, public web artwork copies, per-artist copyright credits, a bilingual copyright/privacy page, repository rights/security notices, EXIF cleanup, synchronized cache versions, and removes unused root legacy duplicates.
